note:
Duties assigned by position under a responsibility sentence ending “by:” whose items are gerunds, from SECTION 2: RESPONSIBILITIES of DoDD 5000.01 (2020), paragraph 2.7.

This form defeated PROMPT_VERSION 3 completely: the model quoted these items correctly and labelled every one SHALL, so the modality-word rule refused each and ADR-030 made the whole chunk a rejection. The section yielded nothing, which is also why it was where the prompt's worked example got echoed in sprint 9 — a section that yields nothing is where a model reaches for something plausible.

Statements are the lettered items with their letters removed and their wrapped lines rejoined, which is what the passage says; the office is the actor, per ADR-033. Each was checked verbatim against the chunk before this file was written, and each was read to confirm it states a duty rather than describing one.

2.7.  DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONAL TEST AND EVALUATION (DOT&E).   
In addition to the acquisition responsibilities in DoDD 5141.02, the DOT&E has overarching 
responsibility for operational and live fire test and evaluation in accordance with Section 139 of 
Title 10, U.S.C, by: 
a.  Prescribing policies and procedures for the conduct of operational and live fire test and 
evaluation in the DoD. 
b.  Reviewing and approving operational and live fire test plans for MDAPs and programs 
designated for DOT&E oversight. 
c.  Providing an independent evaluation of system operational effectiveness, suitability, and 
survivability, including cybersecurity, in reports to DoD acquisition leadership, the Secretary of 
Defense, and the congressional defense committees, based on the operational and live fire testing 
that was conducted. 
d.  Advising programs on the testability of system requirements. 
DoDD 5000.01, September 9, 2020
